title: OpenAI Eyes External Release of Internal 'Pando' Git Backend
summary:
OpenAI is considering making its internal Pando Git backend available to other companies to help them manage the scale of large monorepos. The company has invited interested parties to contact its engineering team to discuss potential access to the source control infrastructure, which was designed to accommodate the heavy data requirements of both human engineers and AI agents.

The custom backend reduced push latency for the developer team by roughly 80% and currently processes nearly 1PB of Git data each day. While the system is tailored for OpenAI's growing internal needs, the company stated that Pando remains compatible with standard Git tools and that it will continue to contribute general improvements back to the open source Git project.
